environment.browser: Codex in-app Browser with Chromium engine

stowed_visual_fidelity.notes: Owned stowed render reviewed for silhouette, tire contact, fork scale, and base-machine proportions.

extended_visual_fidelity.notes: Four owned renders separately expose maximum lift, maximum reach, retract-chain sheave routing, and the double-ended steering ram/bars.

cab_closeup_fidelity.notes: Cab close-up reviewed for open-cab configuration, structure, controls, glazing, and owned-detail consistency.

desktop_browser_interaction.notes: Desktop stow, maximum lift, maximum reach, steering modes, controls, and zero-error diagnostics reviewed.

mobile_browser_interaction.notes: 390 by 844 portrait and 844 by 390 short-landscape layouts reviewed with all five controls reachable.

accessibility_semantics_and_keyboard.notes: Browser accessibility tree, engineering aria values, keyboard modal, focus trap contract, Escape, inert background, and focus restoration reviewed. Physical screen-reader hardware is explicitly not claimed.

semantic_selection.notes: Runtime semantic hit-volume self-test reported 6 of 6 ready and component dialogs restored focus to their opener.

performance_profile.notes: Observed local p95 frame times remained from 16.8 to 18.6 ms; physical low-end mobile GPU performance is not claimed.

600s_browser_regression.notes: 600S route loaded its exact machine identity with zero runtime errors on the isolated static server.

es1930m_browser_regression.notes: ES1930M route loaded its GLB and exact machine identity with zero runtime errors on the isolated static server.
